 Cleveland will look to bounce back after a disappointing 124-112 loss to the Charlotte Hornets on Monday. Donovan Mitchell and Evan Mobley headline a Cavaliers team looking to establish consistency early in the season. Cleveland also has revenge on its mind after suffering a 109-97 home loss to New York on Saturday, giving the Cavaliers an opportunity to even the score in this quick rematch.
